en: In 1279, Kublai Khan finished conquering China.
He had already tried Japan once, in 1274. It did not go well.
So Japan did the reasonable thing. They built a wall.
In 1281, Kublai sent one of the largest invasion fleets in history.
Meanwhile, in Dai Viet, the Mongols were losing too.
In 1258. In 1285. And in 1288, they met wooden stakes, hidden under the tide.
Japan survived. Centuries later, it shut its doors to the world.
Then, in 1905, that same country beat the Russian Empire.
How do you go from that... to that?
This is History of the World.
